headline: Ladakh grants industry status to registered hotels & guest houses
summary: Ladakh has granted industry status to registered hotels and guest houses as a first step to strengthen its hospitality sector. The policy is aimed at revamping the region's hospitality industry.
why: Industry status can give hotels access to policy benefits such as financing and incentives, which matters for tourism-focused investment in India.
